title: Mall world can be heaven or hell…
content: Hey everyone, you know there are people talking about mall world and saying it is not a place you want to go. I’ve never felt like it is a negative thing because it is so interesting to me. I look forward to these dreams because it feels so familiar. I don’t feel scared. It’s just a space of altered consciousness. I strongly believe that if you are scared and if you resist it, it will only get scarier. You have the full power to rewrite the energy in your dreams and channel the positivity. I fully believe you can change where you are going where you are going but in mall world if you feel that it is scary or like a hell. Remember: Positive dreaming energy attracts positive dreaming energy, and negative dreaming energy attracts negative dreaming energy. Some people get trapped in mall world (dreaming the scary part of mall world every night) because they are scared and can’t rewrite their way out. Once you rewrite your way out and say “ok I’m dreaming” you will go to other parts of mall world that are more positive because you won’t be scared to explore.
